skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Mirror Visitor
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'The Curious Trove Manor' Custom Line/Mirror Visitor. The actor—hush, now. Does she play the role of the Master, a guest, or a phantom in the mirror? Until the highest landing is reached, all remains a mystery.
skins.quote: The children absolutely love this costume of Iris's, and to placate them, she might even show up to her recent storytelling tea parties wearing it.
